text_block_list.text: One day, at the training track……

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Pitter-patter-dash-dash-dash! Ehehe, that felt pretty good~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey hey! How was that?
It's called the 'Dark Horse Sprint'!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
In the manga I read yesterday!
An Umamusume called a "dark horse" dashed past like *whooooosh*
and had this super amazing breakthrough!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was completely blown away!
It was super duper cool~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You see! Ever since this morning, I've been copying everything... non-stop! And then, and then...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm s-so tiiired~~...
Being a dark horse is hard work, huh~!
choice_data_list: Explain the proper meaning of a dark horse.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I see, I see, that makes sense~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So she was called a dark horse
because nobody was paying attention to her when she won.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, ooh! If I win, too,
does that mean they'll call me a dark horse?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Because I've never won 1st place before!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: All right! I'll do my best to become a formidable dark horse too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly.
Can't run without any energy, after all~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Alright, training's aaall done!
Time to go home and plaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the advice!
See ya!
